title: Production as a separate reviewed deploy, keeping legacy stacks for 14 days
description:
## Plan step 9 (only after staging is proven; relates to chatticus-89a222)
Same stack order as staging, then migration, then DNS and CloudFront cutover with the marketing intake decision already implemented. Manual dispatch with the environment reviewer approving. Run acceptance. Keep legacy Python stacks and old Messaging items untouched for the 14-day window, then purge-legacy-items.ts. Do not purge early: after the purge there is no rollback.
## Acceptance
- Acceptance passes on production; waitlist and contact still work; 14 days elapse before the purge.
Source: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan). Nothing has been executed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Progress 2026-10-15: production keeps its existing stack names in the production AWS account; the marketing site was cut over to that account (see chatticus-1fa85b). Legacy resources are kept and unused (legacy marketing distribution with aliases removed, legacy ChatticusMarketing stack drifted, Python Function URL and its WAITLIST/CONTACT items, ChatticusThinTurn stacks, ChatticusDns zone). Left open: production acceptance and the retention window and retirement are not done.

right_now_summary: Production uses the new marketing account; legacy resources remain untouched pending acceptance and 14-day retention.
